_comment: Photos supplied by the site owner (25 September 2026). Source and licence still to be confirmed in writing before public launch. They illustrate Ethiopian coffee culture and roasted coffee; they do not depict our exporter partners, their facilities or our team, so they are marked as illustrative. Imported by `npm run images:import`, which only fills empty photo slots and empty featured images.

photos.alt: Coffee poured from a black clay jebena into rows of small white cups during an Ethiopian coffee ceremony
Roasted coffee beans in an open kraft paper bag
Roasted coffee beans spilling from a small traditional Ethiopian coffee cup onto a green surface

A woman holding a red mug of coffee in a warmly lit café
